title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: machinepool role inputs
description: The rendered terraform.tfvars.json of a TerraformMachinePool apply (common.md, machinepool.md). Module inputs are exactly the contract inputs: no other properties.

captf_cluster_outputs.description: The cluster role's exports output, verbatim; {} when the TerraformCluster is externally managed.

replicas.description: The group's desired capacity: MachinePool.spec.replicas with autoscaling disabled, or the observed replicas output on every apply after the first with autoscaling enabled.

bootstrap_data.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of the bootstrap Secret's value key, always encoded (machinepool.md). contentEncoding is an annotation only; the pattern is the assertion.

bootstrap_format.description: The bootstrap Secret's format key; cloud-config when absent.

failure_domains.description: MachinePool.spec.failureDomains; may be [] (the module then chooses). At most 100 entries.

cluster_failure_domains.description: Names read from the cluster's own state's failure_domains output at render time; may be [].

kubernetes_version.description: MachinePool.spec.template.spec.version, verbatim (may carry a +rke2rN suffix), or null.

autoscaling.description: The pool's only autoscaling switch, parsed from the MachinePool's autoscaler min/max-size annotations; {enabled=false, min=0, max=0} when absent, incomplete or invalid.
